The Apple deals are flying now that Amazon’s 2026 Black Friday sale is officially live, but we are also tracking some particularly notable deals on Beats gear. While the AirPods Pro 3 deal is now live at $70 off and, as of this morning, an even lower price on the 2026 AirPods Max 2 at $130 off, we are also tracking the brand new Beats 360 ANC headphones with a deep $100 price drop, a gigantic 53% off the latest Beats Studio Pro headphones, Powerbeats Pro 2 back at the best price yet, and loads more.

Beats Black Friday deals

  • Beats 360 at the best price ever
  • Beats Studio Pro – all-new colors at a giant 53% off
  • Powerbeats Pro 2
  • Beats Pill
  • Beats Powerbeats Pro 2
  • Beats Studio Pro
  • Beats 360
  • Beats Solo 4
  • Beats Powerbeats Fit
  • Beats Studio Buds +

Beats 360 – Best price ever at $100 off

One of the clear headliners of the Beats Black Friday deals has to be the brand new Beats 360 wireless over-ear ANC headphones. Now at a seriously notable $100 off, after testing them out ourselves we said they are about as close to a pair of AirPods Max 2 as you’re going to get, and now they are nearly $300 less expensive while still delivering the unique modular Cushion Kit experience:

  • Beats 360 Wireless Headphones $250 (Reg. $350)

While in some ways the new 360 set replace the Studio Pro, they still feature that iconic form-factor that sits brilliantly on the head and were just injected with a couple new colors over at Amazon. On top of that, you can not only score them at a massive 53% off for Black Friday, but they also come in at $110 less than the deal price on the 360:

  • Beats Studio Pro from $140 (Reg. $300)

Powerbeats Pro 2 – Matching Amazon all-time low

The latest Powerbeats Pro 2 still manage to stand own their own in many ways – there just isn’t very any options out there with this workout-ready design, vibrant color options, built-in Apple Find My action, and built-in heart rate sensors that run on the Apple H2 chip (if any). Regularly $250, you land a set down at $180 shipped right now to match the lowest price we have ever tracked at Amazon

  • Powerbeats Pro 2 $180 (Reg. $250)
